jobs.description:
An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Join an innovative and fast-growing technology company that helps organizations optimize their digital document and information management processes. With a strong reputation in its sector and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its presence across the Belgian market.

Jobomschrijving

• Strong commercial mindset and excellent negotiation skills.
• Autonomous, proactive, and results-driven.
• Comfortable developing a market and creating business opportunities.
• Experience within technology, software, SaaS, services, or solutions sales is a strong advantage.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

Jobomschrijving

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• 

Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

jobs.description:
What you will be working on

The YUFE Alliance is looking for a motivated Communications and Monitoring Officer that will have the opportunity to:

• Take part in the daily operations of the YUFE Central Office in Brussels
• Manage and maintain the website, including content development, monitoring and contact with web developers
• Coordinate the implementation of the YUFE seed funding, including communication and dissemination, support to applicants, selection process and committee, as well as follow-up and iteration of the scheme
• Keep up to date the contact database and distribution lists for YUFE communications
• Support market analysis on our joint educational offers 
• Support our communications content planning, delivery, monitoring and reporting
• Assist in the planning and execution of meetings and events
• Assist in project management tasks such as reporting and dissemination 
What we are looking for

We are looking for a dedicated, proactive team player that wants to contribute to a dynamic team within an international and intercultural environment. As equity, diversity and inclusivity belong to YUFE's core values, we are searching for a colleague fully committed to these principles.

• Ideal start date: January 2027
• You hold a master's degree
• At least 3 years of working experience in a Communications/Dissemination based role or similar
• Good knowledge of MS Office package (experience with SharePoint and Exact Online), Mailchimp, Canva, WordPress, experience with CornerStone is an asset
• You are strong at planning and organisation 
• You have excellent written and oral communication skills in English (any other European language will be an asset)
• You feel at ease to work independently, within a small team and are flexible to support a diverse range of tasks 
What we are offering 

• A contract of indefinite duration (under Belgian law)
• Salary based on experience (and orientated on salary scales of Belgian Universities)
• Competitive package of benefits (meal vouchers, full reimbursement of public transport, group insurance, etc.) 
• An open working environment with attention to your work-life balance and up to 40 days of holidays
• The possibility of working from home two days a week 
• Broadening of your professional networks in Brussels and across the EU

STRATEGY & CEO SUPPORT

¿ Support key decisions with analyses and business cases
¿ Turn priorities into action plans and drive them across departments
¿ Lead cross-functional projects and external partners
¿ Spot growth and efficiency opportunities

RETAIL EXPANSION

¿ Identify and analyze locations for new ateliers
¿ Build business cases on sales potential, investment and returns
¿ Manage real-estate agents, landlords and partners
¿ Run the process from screening to investment decision and budgeting

STRATEGIC & OPERATIONAL PROJECTS

¿ Lead operational improvement projects with production
¿ Support new channels and partnerships, from delivery platforms to a franchise model
¿ Renegotiate supplier contracts and support strategic procurement

PROCESS OPTIMIZATION, AI & AUTOMATION

¿ Find inefficient processes and help teams automate them
¿ Use AI and digital tools to sharpen analyses and productivity
¿ Build practical AI use cases across departments with IT

GROWTH & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

¿ Analyze new growth opportunities
¿ Support strategic B2B opportunities and major accounts, including pricing analyses
¿ Track initiatives and recommend corrective action

 
 
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

¿ 1-3 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking or private equity
¿ Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills
¿ Highly proficient with AI tools and how automation improves processes
¿ Strong project management skills; able to coordinate stakeholders without hierarchical authority
¿ Strong ownership: you make sure things get done
¿ Entrepreneurial, at ease between strategy and execution
¿ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
¿ Fluent in French, Dutch and English
 
WHAT WE OFFER

¿ A seat next to the CEO, at the heart of the biggest decisions
¿ Broad exposure to growing an ambitious Belgian SME
¿ A versatile role across strategy, finance, operations and development
¿ Real autonomy and responsibility from day one
¿ Speed, entrepreneurship and a product to be proud of
¿ A people-first culture: care, accountability, collaboration
¿ Strong growth opportunities
¿ A competitive compensation package

Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven 
 
#Talent 
 
Purpose: 
 
Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. 
 
We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. 
 
We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. 
 
That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT. 
 
Internship description: 
 
The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation. 
 
What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners  
 
Internship duration: 
 
Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.  
 
Work environment 
 
Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation: 
 
Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University. 
 
 
 
Why build your career with us: 
 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE  
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
 
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. 
 
If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today. 
  

#LI-ABI ZoneEUR

jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + German + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, Finnish, Swedish, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed
• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks
• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations
• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background
• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)
• Hands-on and dynamic approach
• Precision and results-oriented mindset
• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility
• Team player who can also work independently
• Preferably experienced in welding
• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus
